The Router was not too lenient; in fact, it appropriately penalized the image for failing these hard biological constraints despite the classifier's confidence.

The score reflects a partial match on general shape/snout but failure on specific diagnostic traits.

The tail fin lacks structural definition and blends into the background (Severity 2). While the segmentation mask is clean (high confidence), the internal structure is biologically implausible for the target class. The image resembles a generated hybrid of a sturgeon and a catfish, leading to significant structural artifacts relative to the ground truth class.
